verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents automation through its CLI, SDK, REST API, an agent skill, and templates. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in way to version, review, or roll back automations or template configurations. Templates and scoped API keys are adjacent features, not versioning or rollback, so the axis applies but has no evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
